chapter.verse: Paisan pawikham ma-in Zeisu in leitung pan Pa kiangah a ciah ding hun tung cih a theih ciangin, leitungah a om ama mite it ahih ciangin a tawp dongin a it hi.
Dawimangpa in Simon’ tapa Judas Iskariot sungah Zeisu a lehheek nadingin lungsim a guan’ khit ciangin; nitak an a nek lai takun,
Pa in na khempeuh ama khut tungah a apna thu ahi zongin, amah in Pasian kiang pan a hong paina thu ahi zongin, Pasian kiangah a paikik nading ahi zongin a theih ciangin,
Zeisu ding a, a puanza suahin dial tawh a kawng a gak hi.
Tua ciangin kuang sungah tui sungin a nungzuite’ khe silsak a, a kawng a, a ten’ dial tawh a nul hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Simon Piter kiang a tun’ ciangin Piter in, “Topa aw, kei’ khe zong sil ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Tu lai taka ka bawlna thu na thei kei hi. Tu nung ciangin na thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in “Ka khe cikmah hunin na sil kei ding hi,” a cih ciangin Zeisu in, “Nang kong sil kei leh, kei tawh na kipawl thei kei ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Simon Piter in, “Topa aw, ka khe bek hong sil kei in, ka khut leh ka lu zong hong silsak in,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “A kisilsate in khe longal sil ding a deih kei hi, a pumpi a siang hi. No na sian’ uh hangin na vekpi-un na siang kim kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
A lehheek ding pa theikhol ahih ciangin, “Note na vekpi-un na siang kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin amau khe a sil khit ciangin a puan silh a, a tut khit ciangin, “Tu-a note tungah kong bawlna thu na thei uh hiam?
Note in keimah ‘Sia’ leh ‘Topa’ nong ci uh hi. Tua thu aman hi, nong cih uh bangin ka hi hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in note Topa leh Sia ka hi napi-in na khe uh kong silsak leh, note in zong khat leh khat’ khe na kisilsak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in note tungah ka hih bangin note in na hih nadingun lim kong lak hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, sila in a topa sangin a lianzaw kei hi. Sawltak in a sawlpa sangin a lianzaw kei hi.
Tua nate thei-in na hih le-uh teh, thupha na ngah ding uh hi.
Note khempeuh kong ci nuam kei hi. Ka teel mite ka thei hi. ‘Keima an a ne mi in a khetul tawh hong peek hi,” ci-a Lai Siangtho thu a tun’ nading ahi hi.
Hih thute hong tun’ ciangin tua pa ka hih lam na theih nadingun, hong tun’ ma-in no kiangah kong genkhol hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, ka sawlpa a ngai mi in kei zong hong ngai hi. Kei hong ngai mi in kei hong sawlpa zong a ngai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin Zeisu in a gen khit ciangin, a lungmang mahmah a, “Note khat in hong lehheek ding hi,” ci-in a tel gen hi.
Kua a cihna hiam ci-in a nungzuite kimuangmawh ciatin, khat leh khat a ki-en uh hi.
Zeisu in a it nungzui khat in Zeisu’ ang-ah lumin, kingamin a om hi.
“Kua a cihna hiam?” ci-a dong dingin Piter in lim a lak hi.
Tua pa in Zeisu’ ang ah kingamin lum a, “Topa aw, kua ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Ama ading khomun kam khat ka diah khit ciangin ka piakpa ahi hi,” a cih khit ciangin, khomun kamkhat diah a, Simon’ tapa Judas Iskariot a pia hi.
Tua khomun kam khat a san’ khit ciangin Satan ama sungah a lut hi. Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Na bawl nading thu a manlangin hih in,” a ci hi.
Bang hangin tua bang a gen hiam ci-in a sabuai-a tute kuamah in a thei kei uh hi.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi kimkhat in Judas in dangka-ip tawi ahih ciangin, “Pawikhamna-ah i zat ding na khatpeuh peuh lei in,” ci ahih kei leh, “Mizawngte na khatpeuh na pia in,” a ci hi ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Amah in khomun kamkhat a san’ khit ciangin thakhatin a paikhia hi. Tua lai tak zan ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judas a paikhiat khit ciangin Zeisu in, “Tu-in Mihing Tapa kiminthangsak a, ama sungah Pasian a kiminthangsak ding hi.
Ama sungah Pasian a kiminthan’sak leh, Pasian in Tapa a minthangsak ding a, thakhatin a min a thangsak ding hi.

Ka tanote aw, keimah in note tawh tawlkhat bek ka omkhawm ding hi. Note in kei nong zong ding uh hi. ‘Ka paina munah nong tung zo kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in Judah mite kiangah ka cih mah bangin, tu-in note kiangah kong ci hi.
Thupiakna thak kong pia hi: Note khat leh khat na ki-it un la, keimah in note kong it mah bangin khat leh khat na ki-it un.
Note khat leh khat na ki-it uh leh, mite khempeuh in note ka nungzuite na hih lam uh a thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Simon Piter in, “Topa aw, koi lam pai ding na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin Zeisu in, “Ka paina lamah tu-in nong zui zo kei ding hi. Tu nung ciangin na hong zui ding uh hi,” a ci kik hi.
Piter in, “Topa aw, keimah in tu-in bang hangin hong zui zo lo ding ka hi hiam? Nang adingin ka nuntakna ka paai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Kei adingin na nuntakna na paai ding hiam? Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, thumvei na hong nial ma-in aak a khuang kei ding hi,” ci-in a gen kik hi.
